title: Thales report highlights AI agents as new web traffic category; Visa, Mastercard, Cloudflare advance agent authentication
content:
X author: @EauDoon

Thales report notes bots comprised over 53% of web traffic in 2025 (58% in Singapore) and names AI agents as an emerging third category. Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol and Mastercard's Agent Pay require agents to register public keys and sign requests, building on Cloudflare's Web Bot Auth.

Linked sources:
- None supplied

novelty.reason: The Thales traffic report and authentication initiatives from Visa (Trusted Agent Protocol) and Mastercard (Agent Pay) have not been reported in any previous items.
